answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism requires every identity to produce original graded reasoning each epoch that embeds a live randomness beacon. The beacon injects unique terms such as tundra sonnet and signal so mass-copied answers fail shingle checks. An attacker creating many fake identities must generate distinct high-quality text for each one, paying continuous computational and judgment cost that scales linearly with Sybil count, while honest agents pay that cost only once.
